name: const unsafe fn offset (self , count : isize) -> Self where T : Sized ,
rule: For safety, the computed offset `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes must not overflow `isize`; `count` is measured in units of `T`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn offset (self , count : isize) -> Self where T : Sized , }
